questions.question: When was the ibuprofen allergy or wheeze first recorded, and how was it documented previously?
Has the ibuprofen reaction been assessed or confirmed in earlier entries?
Are other NSAIDs or alternative analgesics recorded, and were any stopped or switched because of this reaction?
Is there any recorded asthma or prior respiratory reaction to medications?
Have allergy details been added to the allergy list or communicated to other clinicians?
